summary: A machine-learning post-translational-modification signature for lung adenocarcinoma prognosis and immunotherapy stratification, identifying B4GALT2 as an immune-exclusion-associated regulator.
questions: What is the role of B4GALT2 in immune exclusion in lung adenocarcinoma?
Can post-translational-modification signatures predict LUAD immunotherapy response?
Which biomarkers link B4GALT2 to anti-PD-1 response?
